title: Asia stocks attempt a rebound with central banks in the spotlight
title_zh: 亚洲股市试图反弹，各国央行成为焦点
summary: By Gregor Stuart Hunter SINGAPORE, March 17 (Reuters) - Stocks climbed in early Asian trading on Tuesday, pressing for a second day of gains as investors confronted a crowded central bank calendar and
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 3 月 17 日 - 周二亚洲早盘股市上涨，因投资者面对拥挤的央行日历和压力，股市有望连续第二天上涨。

title: Nvidia goes all in on AI vision at GTC: Takeaways from CEO keynote
title_zh: Nvidia 在 GTC 上全力推进人工智能愿景：CEO 主题演讲要点
summary: Nvidia's (NVDA) GTC 2026 event — the so-called "Super Bowl of AI" — kicked off on Monday with a keynote address from CEO Jensen Huang, where the chip executive announced the launch of the new NemoClaw stack open source AI agent platform OpenClaw, heightened demand for Blackwel...
summary_zh: Nvidia (NVDA) 的 GTC 2026 活动——所谓的“人工智能超级碗”——于周一拉开帷幕，首席执行官黄仁勋发表了主题演讲，这位芯片高管宣布推出新的 NemoClaw 堆栈开源人工智能代理平台 OpenClaw，增加了对 Blackwel 的需求……

title: Wall Street ends higher as traders return to AI stocks
title_zh: 随着交易员重返人工智能股票，华尔街收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Monday, with the Dow gaining more than eight-tenths of a percent, the S&P 500 adding one percent and the Nasdaq climbing nearly one-and-a-quarter percent.:: FileOil prices dropped modestly after the U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周一收高，道琼斯指数上涨逾十分之八，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1%，纳斯达克指数上涨近四分之一。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures inch down after stocks bounce back amid 3-week losing streak
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标普 500 指数、纳斯达克期货小幅下跌，股市在连续三周下跌后反弹
summary: Stocks rebounded Monday, bucking a three-week downward trend as oil prices eased from a recent peak.
summary_zh: 随着油价从近期高点回落，股市周一反弹，扭转了三周的下跌趋势。

title: Uber, Nvidia plan robotaxi rollout in 28 cities starting next year
title_zh: Uber 和 Nvidia 计划明年开始在 28 个城市推出机器人出租车
summary: Uber Technologies and Nvidia said on Monday they will deploy a fleet of robotaxis powered by Nvidia's autonomous driving software ‌on the ride-hailing network, starting in Los Angeles and San Francisco ‌in 2027 and expanding to 28 cities globally by 2028.
summary_zh: Uber Technologies 和 Nvidia 周一表示，他们将在叫车网络上部署由 Nvidia 自动驾驶软件驱动的机器人出租车车队，从 2027 年在洛杉矶和旧金山开始，到 2028 年扩展到全球 28 个城市。

title: Nvidia launches Groq 3 AI chip and CPU server aimed at Intel during GTC 2026
title_zh: Nvidia 在 GTC 2026 期间推出针对英特尔的 Groq 3 AI 芯片和 CPU 服务器
summary: Nvidia on Monday unveiled its new Groq 3 processor and its effort to take on Intel in the CPU space during the chipmaker's GTC event.
summary_zh: Nvidia 周一在该芯片制造商的 GTC 活动期间推出了新的 Groq 3 处理器，并在 CPU 领域与英特尔展开了较量。

title: Okta CEO: AI is moving so quickly, companies must change 40% of what they are doing every year
title_zh: Okta首席执行官：人工智能发展如此之快，公司每年必须改变40%的工作
summary: Okta co-founder & CEO Todd McKinnon serves up a reality check to companies looking to survive the AI revolution.
summary_zh: Okta 联合创始人兼首席执行官托德·麦金农 (Todd McKinnon) 为那些希望在人工智能革命中生存下来的公司提供了现实检验。

title: Elizabeth Warren asks Meta, Amazon, and others why they're laying workers off despite tax perks
title_zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 询问 Meta、亚马逊和其他公司为何不顾税收优惠而裁员
summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren is grilling several major employers, including Amazon, Target, and UPS, about their recent spate of layoffs amid tax perks to corporations.
summary_zh: 参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 正在质问亚马逊、塔吉特 (Target) 和 UPS 等几家主要雇主，询问他们最近因企业税收优惠而进行的一系列裁员。

title: AI companies continue cross-investment as ROI questions loom
title_zh: 投资回报率问题迫在眉睫，人工智能公司继续交叉投资
summary: Bokeh Capital Partners founder and CIO Kimberly Forrest and Freedom Capital Markets managing director Paul Meeks share their thoughts on the trajectory of the AI trade, and at what point return on investment can be expected.
summary_zh: Bokeh Capital Partners 创始人兼首席投资官 Kimberly Forrest 和 Freedom Capital Markets 董事总经理 Paul Meeks 分享了他们对人工智能行业发展轨迹的看法，以及什么时候可以预期投资回报。
